text: Owner's answer (2026-11-26) to your salary question: «Болно». A holder of hr.payroll.manage MAY set or change an employee-only salary override on their own record, as original ADR-0244 says. So drop the provisional guard the brain asked for in 20261126T075725633Z-brain-2be049: no self restriction on the individual override in 0125. This is separate from positions, where the rule of 2026-11-25 stays (only ADMIN assigns or moves a position, nobody changes their own). State the override rule plainly in ADR-0244 and the payroll guide, keep the override change audited like any other pay change, and keep amounts hidden without hr.payroll.view or ADMIN.
